name: Bard of Ancient Tales
data: [{"name": "Bard of Ancient Tales","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You have been taught the Ancient Tales of your Kin:  tales of heroes, gods, monsters, and mighty deeds, and you use this knowledge to your advantage.\n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  You gain a +10 bonus to your Songs & Tales Skill, and whenever you Help one of your companions, you always add the number of your Songs & Tales ranks (not the Skill Bonus) to the Helping bonus you grant. For example, if you have 12 ranks in the Songs & Tales Skill, when you successfully Help one of your companions, you grant them a total bonus of +22 (+10 for the Helping Roll, and +12 for your ranks in Songs & Tales).\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, when you are in a safe environment with your companions, if there is no unspent Bardic Inspiration Token in play, you may take some time to tell them a tale or sing them a song about a situation similar to the one you're facing. After you've done so, you create a Bardic Inspiration Token (use a glass bead or similar to represent it). Any character that listened to you can spend a Bardic Inspiration Token to gain a bonus equal to your Songs & Tales ranks (not the Skill Bonus) to any Skill, Attack, or Save Roll, even after they've rolled the dice. Once used, the Bardic Inspiration Token is discarded.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}, {"name": "Bard of Ancient Tales","type": "Modifier","data": {"notes": "You gain a +10 bonus to your Songs & Tales Skill.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","inEffect": false,"alwaysOn": false,"attack": false,"defence": false,"skill": true,"spell": false,"check": false,"reaction": false,"damage": false,"primary": false,"entries": {"0": {"value": 0,"formula": "","category": "attack","targets": ""},"1": {"value": 10,"formula": "10","category": "skill","targets": "Songs & Tales"}},"tempName": "Bard of Ancient Tales"}}]

data: [{"name": "Loremaster","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You are a scholar, a chronicler, a sage. data: [{"name": "Lovable Rogue","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You are a scoundrel, a crook, a liar, a ne'er-do-well. name: Rogue Mage
data: [{"name": "Rogue Mage","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You were born with an innate magical ability or developed it after a unique occurance. You can't really explain why or how your magic works, but using it is as natural as breathing to you. \n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  Include something about your magical ability in one of your Passions. Select any one Spell Lore of your choosing and add it to your Kin Spell Lores (see Magic chapter for more information on Spell Lores).\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, you can spend one point of Drive to gain the ability of casting spells from the chosen Spell Lore without spending MPs for a scene. At the end of that scene, you become Weary if you weren't Weary, and you drop unconscious for 1d10 hours if you were. However, you're hunted by a powerful NPC because of your powers.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}]

name: Shapechanger
data: [{"name": "Shapechanger","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "The totemic animal of your people blesses you with a righteous fury, granting you the strength to crush your enemies.\n- Minor (cost 2 BPs):  Choose a Medium-sized wild animal (like a wolf, a boar, or a mountain lion) as the totem of your people. Whenever you become Bruised or whenever you gain a point of Drive because of one of your Passions, you can assume the form of the animal you've chosen. While in this form, you have the AT, DEF, HP, natural physical abilities, Skills and attacks (you can choose if using the animal CMB or your Brawl Skill bonus when using these attacks) of your totemic animal, or your own Skill bonus +10, whichever is higher. Your Lore and mental Skills (those Skills that require concentration and human intellect) suffer instead a penalty of -50. While in animal form you can not speak nor cast Spells. You're also pervaded by a bestial fury. At the beginning of each Assessment Phase, if you're not Engaged, you must pass a Perception Roll or attack the nearest creature. You revert to your original form if you're Incapacitated or if there aren't enemies within sight and you pass your Perception Roll. When you return to your original form, you become Weary.\n- Major (cost 4 BPs):  you can also choose a Large animal as your totem, and you can spend a point of Drive to transform into your totemic animal with a Full Action.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}]

name: Stormcrow
data: [{"name": "Stormcrow","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You are cursed with a peculiar ability. But you know what's coming and prepare for the worst.\n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  Write one of your Passions about your visions, and increase the total value of your Wisdom by 5 points.\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, whenever one of your allies spends a point of Drive to re-roll a failed Skill or Save Roll and fails again, you may spend a Free Action to have a vision of doom. data: [{"name": "Unbreakable Bond","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "The road may be dark before you, but you're not alone to face it. name: Underground Uprising
data: [{"name": "Underground Uprising","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You spent your youth in the company of thieves, ruffians, or others criminals. You may have left those years behind you, but you have never completely severed your ties with the underworld. \n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  Write something about your relationship with your criminal contacts in your Allegiance. You can use your network of contacts to call in favors or get better prices in the black market. Whenever you're buying stolen or illegal goods, you can treat your WL as if it were 2 levels higher (up to a maximum WL of 4).\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, once per session whenever you are in a town, city, or other civilized settlement, you may spend one point of Drive to declare that you have a contact in the local criminal underworld that might help you in the situation at hand. Name the NPC introduced this way. They must actually lend you some kind of help to solve the specified situation but, besides that, they're controlled by the GM like any other NPC and aren't forced to help you for free (they're criminals, after all).","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}]

name: Unorthodox Education
data: [{"name": "Unorthodox Education","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You started learning the ropes of a different Vocation than the one you belong to now, but either soon discovered that it wasn't your calling or were somehow forced to interrupt your training. \n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  Choose a Skill in which you have no Vocational Bonuses. You gain a special +10 bonus to that Skill.\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, choose a Vocation different than yours and a Skill Category in which that Vocation gets at least 2 DPs each Level. At each Level, you get one less Development Point to spend in the Skill Category your Vocation gets the most DPs (choose one when you select this Option if more Categories get the same number of DPs), and one additional Development Point to spend in the chosen category for the other Vocation. However, you gained the enmity of a powerful individual during your training. Name your enemy and write your Allegiance about them. name: Vigilant
data: [{"name": "Vigilant","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "An adventurous life taught you to sleep lightly and be always ready for trouble.\n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  Four hours of rest are enough to give you the benefits of a full night of sleep. This doesn't change your HPs recovery rate, but allows you to recover from the Weary condition and regain all spent MPs with 4 hours of rest.\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, you can take Full Actions, attack, and Parry normally when you are Surprised. You are still considered Surprised for the purpose of resolving your foe's attacks and special abilities. However, there's a reason why you're always watchful. Someone or something is out there to get you. Name your enemy and write an Allegiance about them.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}]

name: Well Traveled
data: [{"name": "Well Traveled","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You travelled far and wide, and are familiar with many places and ways unknown to the majority of people.\n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  You gain one rank in Wandering and you know the location of a Safe Haven. Once during the game, unless your character is in the Darklands, you can declare that a Safe Haven is near, and mark it on the map within 1d5 days of travel from your character's position. Once you've done this, you lose this ability, but the Safe Haven remains available to you and your companions.\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Additionally, once per session when your party is Preparing for Travel, you may ask the GM to reveal an alternative, secret, or rarely used route to your destination, without any Skill Roll.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}, {"name": "Ranks:  Well Traveled","type": "Variable","data": {"notes": "You gain one rank in Wandering and you know the location of a Safe Haven.","chartype": "CharacterVsD","value": 0,"formula": "","label": "","entries": {"0": {"value": null,"formula": "","label": ""},"1": {"value": 1,"formula": "1","label": "Wandering"}}}}]

name: Wyrd
data: [{"name": "Wyrd","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You are bound by a strange fate. Improbable and unpredictable things seems to happen with alarming frequency around you, for good or bad. \n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  Whenever you make an Open-Ended Roll, you must re-roll the dice and add the result on an Unmodified Roll of 95 or more, instead of the normal 96 or more. You must also re-roll and subtract the result on an Unmodified Roll of 06 or less, instead of the standard 05 or less.\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  Whenever you make an Open-Ended Roll, you must re-roll the dice and add the result on an Unmodified Roll of 93 or more, instead of the normal 96 or more. You must also re-roll and subtract the result on an Unmodified Roll of 08 or less, instead of the standard 05 or less","chartype": "CharacterVsD","category": "quirk"}}]

name: Mark of Destiny
data: [{"name": "Mark of Destiny","type": "Trait","data": {"notes": "You carry a strange mark on your body, that was there since you were born or since a very particular occasion. Sometimes it throbs or causes you discomfort, as if to warn you of something. You still haven't figured out the secret it hides, but one thing is certain:  your own destiny is tightly connected to it.\n- Minor (cost 1 BP):  You have a unique permanent mark (a scar, a birthmark, a tattoo, or anything similar) on a prominent part of your body. Describe it, then choose one of the following:  servants of the Darkmaster, magic, or a specific kind of creature (demons, orcs, undead, etc). Your mark will always warn you when you're in the presence of what you chose (you decide how; it could throb, glow softly, cause you migraines, bleed, etc). You get a -10 penalty to all Perception Rolls to notice anything else when your mark is 'active', because of the distraction.\n- Major (cost 3 BPs):  You also gain an additional Passion, named 'Destiny' representing your uncommon fate. Write it together with the GM and the rest of the group, and remember to link it to your mark somehow (i.e.:  'the blood of the ancient Archmages flows in my veins', or 'I carry the mark of the Dragonslayer of legends').
